did_you_know.fact: On June 8, 2004: The first Venus Transit in well over a century takes place, the previous one being in 1882.

image_credit.author: Original uploader was Mswggpai at en.wikipedia

did_you_know.fact: On June 8, 1992: The first World Oceans Day is celebrated, coinciding with the Earth Summit held in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
June 8 is observed as Primož Trubar Day (Slovenia).

On June 8, 2007: Newcastle, New South Wales, Australia, is hit by the State's worst storms and flooding in 30 years, resulting in the death of nine people and the grounding of a trade ship, the MV Pasha Bulker.
On June 8, 2007: Space Shuttle Atlantis is launched on STS-117 carrying two truss segments and solar arrays to the International Space Station.
